parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural signal is limited to the alias declaration shape itself rather than any shared logic or members. `LargeNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, and `Header` are intentionally distinct widget view aliases serving different WidgetKit size roles (small, medium, large) and a header component — their coincidence is purely syntactic (each is a one-line typealias at line 13–14 in its respective file). Collapsing them would conflate semantically distinct widget entry-point types and break WidgetKit's size-specific view resolution. No shared fields or methods exist to extract, so there is nothing actionable to consolidate.
